note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997). The original is in English; alate, soldier and worker are all present. Measurements include those legible in the text; synonymy citations, distribution records and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish white to brownish yellow; antennae, legs and body paler than head. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.8–4.9 mm. Head capsule elliptical, widest posteriorly, narrowing anteriorly (0.82–0.96 mm to base of mandibles, maximum width 0.75–0.86 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 slightly smaller than segments 3 and 4 combined, the latter two subequal in length. Labrum long, lanceolate, reaching 3/4 of the mandibles (0.30–0.37 mm long, maximum width 0.23–0.25 mm), sides convex, apex broader. Mandibles thin and weak, apex weakly incurved, toothless (0.49–0.55 mm long); slightly longer than half the head length (mandible length/head length index 0.58–0.61). Postmentum well arched, slightly longer than wide (0.38–0.45 mm long, maximum width 0.35–0.43 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.27–0.37 mm long, 0.48–0.58 mm wide); anterior margin deeply notched, posterior margin weakly incurved.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to straw yellow; body nearly white. Head and body moderately pilose. Body length 3.6–4.5 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (0.78–0.85 mm to base of mandibles, maximum width 0.85–0.95 mm). Antennae 14–15-segmented; segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 combined. Postclypeus inflated, nearly half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.20–0.25 mm long, 0.45–0.50 mm wide); anterior margin with a distinct notch, posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head light chestnut brown to brown, with a smoky tinge; antennae, postclypeus, labrum and pronotum yellowish brown; pronotum with a pale yellow T-shaped marking and humeral spots; abdomen brown above, pale yellow below. Head and body rather densely pilose; wing membrane with minute hairs. Body length without wings 8.75–9.70 mm. Head capsule subcircular (1.0–1.15 mm to base of mandibles, 1.35–1.48 mm wide including compound eyes); coronal suture weak or indistinct. Fontanelle a small round white spot. Compound eyes medium-sized, round (maximum diameter 0.35–0.43 mm, minimum diameter 0.30–0.39 mm), close to the lower margin of the head. Ocellus large, elliptical (long diameter 0.16–0.25 mm, short diameter 0.12–0.17 mm), separated from compound eye by about 1/3 of its diameter (eye–ocellus distance 0.04–0.06 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 3 shortest or subequal to segment 5, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3 or segment 5. Postclypeus inflated, strongly arched, slightly more than 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum trapezoidal (0.75–0.85 mm long, maximum width 1.20–1.38 mm); anterior margin slightly raised, weakly incurved at middle; posterior margin also slightly incurved. Wings long and pilose; wing membrane with minute lamellate cuticular rods; forewing 13.5 mm long.
